messages:
neha: Heads-up — started seeing p95/p99 latency regressions and a few timeouts after the quant-profile rollout (int8 + experimental fp8) at ~08:15 UTC. Affected models: rwd-llama-13b and rwd-3b. API errors showed `504` and `request_timeout`.
ops-bot: [alert] latency.p99 > 2s for cluster-prod-us-west (service: inference) at 08:20 UTC. incident_id=INC-20260715-42
liam: Thanks — are we sure it lines up with the quant rollout? Any deploy IDs or config changes?
neha: Yes — rollout changed `quant_profile=v2-int8-fp8` via console at 08:12. I grabbed a couple of traces: `x-request-id=abcd1234`, avg_token_latency jumped from ~20ms -> 60ms for 13b. Repro curl below: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-13b","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -w "
%{time_total}
"` returned `0.62` seconds.
sara: Noted. Can you paste the runtime logs around the request ids? Also check if KV cache hits changed (could be cache miss storm after quant switch).
neha: Pasted sample from runtime logs: `2026-07-15T08:18:22Z [worker-7] model=rwd-llama-13b quant_mode=int8.fp8 calib_version=2026-07-15T07:55:00 load_time=1.2s step=generate token_latency_ms=65 kv_cache_hit=false`. Looks like `kv_cache_hit=false` more often.
liam: If KV cache became incompatible due to calibration changes that would explain P99 uptick. Two quick mitigations: 1) toggle model-level override to `fp16` to force fallback, 2) roll the quant-profile back. Which is faster?
sara: Toggling model override to `fp16` is fastest and non-disruptive. We can do it with the admin API: `POST /admin/models/rwd-llama-13b/override {"runtime_config":{"quant_mode":"fp16"}}` — do a canary on one shard first. If that fixes p99, we keep until proper recalibration.
kmurphy: +1 on canary. Also reduce max_batch_size to 8 for that model to limit stragglers: `PATCH /admin/models/... {"batching":{"max_batch_size":8}}`. Might hurt throughput but reduces tail.
neha: I'll run the fp16 override on one canary shard now and watch p95/p99. Will report within 10 mins.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] admin change applied to shard-4 by neha at 08:27 UTC. change_id=chg-789
liam: If canary shows improvement, we'll schedule a staged rollback of the quant profile and open a calibration ticket for the fp8 path. Assign to eng-ml for deep dive.
sara: Also temporary routing option: send rwd-llama-13b traffic to dedicated-pool-2 which still runs fp16 builds. Use routing rule `model=rwd-llama-13b -> pool=dedicated-pool-2` for emergency if override slow.
neha: Canary looks good so far — p99 dropped from ~2.1s -> 430ms for the sample traffic. kv_cache_hit reverted to true on canary. I'll expand to 25% rollout and monitor.
liam: Great. Action log: (1) canary fp16 override by neha, (2) if stable at 25% for 15m, expand to 100%, (3) open eng-ml ticket for quant recalibration and include calibration artifacts + perf traces, (4) consider a regen of KV cache migration tooling to make quant transitions smoother.
sara: Filing the ticket now: ML-4672 "fp8/int8 calibration drift causing KV cache incompatibility -> p99 spike". cc eng-ml.
neha: Will follow up with raw traces and example request ids in the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
